subject: Payment route & vendor setup: PO vs company card — follow-up and asks
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira.k@stellara.io>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-18T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Follow-up from demo — procurement & payment route

Alex — thanks for the demo this morning. Quick recap and a few asks from procurement so we can move faster on next steps:

- Procurement preference: Our AP team prefers a PO-based commercial path for new vendors. They require vendor onboarding (vendor form + W9 + company insurance) before issuing a PO.
- Timeline: Procurement estimates 2–4 weeks for vendor onboarding once we return their vendor registration packet.
- Payment terms: They typically approve net-30, but for enterprise deals they will consider net-60 on a case-by-case basis (needs finance approval).
- Marketplace option: Is Redwood available on AWS Marketplace or other cloud marketplaces? If so, it may allow a faster procurement route.
- Pilot/payment workaround: We have a small internal proving budget and could issue a company card for an immediate pilot if procurement timing blocks us more than ~3 weeks.

Attached: Stellara_AP_Policy.pdf (their AP guidance excerpt)

Primary ask: Can you send your standard MSA, a vendor register-ready package (W9, EIN, tax docs), and a short SOW / pilot quote we can route to procurement? Also confirm if Redwood can accept PO + net-30 (or net-60 with approval) and whether you support marketplace purchasing.

Thanks — Samira
Samira Khan
Director, Cloud Partnerships
Stellara Therapeutics


From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.k@stellara.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-18T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up from demo — procurement & payment route

Samira — really appreciate the clear recap and the AP excerpt. I attached our annotated MSA and a short SOW template for the pilot you mentioned (see Redwood_MSA_annotated.docx and SOW_template.pdf). A few clarifying notes and asks from our side: 

- PO acceptance: We do accept POs. Our standard approach for new enterprise customers is to sign the MSA (or a redline), complete vendor onboarding, then accept the PO referencing the signed MSA. Net-30 is our default; net-60 is possible but would need manager approval from finance.
- Marketplace: We are an AWS Marketplace seller in several regions, which can speed procurement if Stellara is set up to purchase there. I'll confirm the exact Marketplace seller/pricing record for your account.
- Pilot on card: If procurement will take >3 weeks, the card-based pilot is the fastest path. We can issue an initial invoice and cap the pilot spend at whatever limit you set.
- Vendor registration: Can you share the vendor form fields (I saw the AP policy excerpt but not the form). I'll have finance complete our vendor packet and return it within 48 business hours once I have the form.

Next steps I propose: 
1) Alex to confirm AWS Marketplace seller details and return vendor packet + W9 (EOD tomorrow).
2) Stellara to confirm preferred route (PO vs card vs marketplace) and procurement contact.
3) If PO, both sides share redlines and target for MSA signature; if card, agree pilot scope and initial invoice amount.

Looping Marissa (revenue lead) and Karthik (finance) to align on approvals and standard pilot credit.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com
Cell: +1 (415) 555-0187

Attachments: Redwood_MSA_annotated.docx, SOW_template.pdf


From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-18T14:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up from demo — procurement & payment route

Alex — short guidance from revenue/ops side:

- Offer two practical paths to close the pilot: 1) PO path: require signed MSA + vendor packet (W9, insurance, vendor form). Typical vendor onboarding 2–4 weeks. If procurement needs SOC2 evidence, we provide link to our compliance page and SOC2 report under NDA.
- 2) Marketplace path: If Stellara will buy through AWS Marketplace, sales motion is much faster — confirm the AWS account email and we can provide the marketplace SKU and pricing.
- 3) Card/punchout: For immediate momentum we can accept a corporate card for a limited pilot. Recommend capping at $50k unless AP indicates a different value.

Commercial levers: we can offer a pilot credit (up to 10% of pilot value) contingent on signing an MSA within 30 days. If procurement insists on net-60, that must go to finance for approval — Karthik, please advise if the deal economics support net-60 for D-2026-0791.

Alex — capture the procurement contact and the vendor form, then route them to our vendor onboarding (vendor@redwoodinference.com). Put the HubSpot deal link in your notes (https://hubspot.com/deals/DEAL-0791) and mark payment-route as PO-preferred for now.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Procurement Team <procurement@stellara.io>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>, Samira Khan <samira.k@stellara.io>
Date: 2026-11-20T14:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up from demo — procurement & payment route

Alex / Samira — thanks for the details. Quick confirmations from procurement: 

- Preferred route: PO. We will initiate vendor onboarding once Redwood returns a completed vendor registration form and tax documents. Please complete the attached Vendor_Registration_Form.pdf and return along with your W9.
- Payment terms: We can process net-30 by default. Net-60 requires Finance sign-off; please provide a billing contact and an initial invoice so our Finance team can evaluate.
- Marketplace: We are interested in AWS Marketplace as an alternate procurement channel. Please provide the Marketplace seller ID and whether the invoice can be routed via Marketplace billing.
- Pilot request: If Redwood can issue an invoice for a pilot (estimated $15k) to the billing contact below, we can approve an expedited payment to get technical validation underway while vendor onboarding proceeds.

Billing contact: Dana Phillips (dana.phillips@stellara.io), AP team
Attached: Vendor_Registration_Form.pdf (please fill and return)

We appreciate the flexibility. If you can return the completed vendor packet by EOD Monday, we will aim to issue a PO within 10 business days thereafter.

Regards,
Stellara Procurement
procurement@stellara.io
